name: Retail store manager -> Customer Success Manager (career change)

job.title: Customer Success Manager
job.description:
Jamf is hiring a Customer Success Manager to help schools and businesses get the most from our Apple device management software.

Responsibilities:
- Own a book of 60+ customer accounts after onboarding
- Drive adoption, renewals and expansion
- Run quarterly business reviews with customer leaders
- Track health scores and spot churn risk early
- Work with Sales and Support to resolve escalations
- Capture customer feedback for the product team

Requirements:
- 3+ years in customer success, account management or a customer-facing leadership role
- Strong relationship building and communication
- Experience with Salesforce or Gainsight
- Comfort learning technical products
- SaaS experience a plus

professionalSummary.summary: Retail store manager with 8 years leading teams, growing sales and turning unhappy customers into regulars.

achievements: Ran a store with $14M in annual sales and a team of 45
Grew membership sign-ups 35% year over year by coaching the team on the conversation
Raised the store's customer satisfaction score from 78 to 86
Handled escalated customer issues and returns over $500
Hired and trained 3 assistant managers, 2 since promoted to store manager
Led the guest service team and ran weekly sales huddles
